title: Settings
subtitle: Manage playback, library, and app integrations.

language.title: Application Language
language.description: Choose the interface language. System default follows your OS locale.

playback.heading: Audio settings
playback.fullscreenStyleHint: Choose between the classic split layout and the ambient glass Still style.
playback.lowPerformanceHint: Disable glass blurs, ambient shaders, and visualizer loops to reduce GPU usage while gaming or on low-power hardware.
playback.visualizerHint: Show the live frequency spectrum visualizer in the player bar when using the Browser audio backend.

ambient.title: Still ambient audio reactivity
ambient.description: Drag or resize the box to choose which frequencies and amplitudes drive Still fullscreen highlights.
ambient.browserOnlyHint: Live spectrum preview & reactivity require the Browser audio backend.

lyrics.label: Lyrics source preference

hints.embedded: Prefer lyrics embedded in audio files, then fall back to sidecars.
hints.synchronized: Prefer lyrics with the highest synchronization quality, regardless of source.
hints.sidecar: Prefer external lyrics files, then fall back to embedded lyrics.

lyrics.ignoreEmbeddedHint: When Synchronized mode is active, skip embedded lyrics and use only external sidecar files.

discord.title: Discord Rich Presence
discord.description: Shows the current track and audio progress in Discord.
discord.imgurIdPlaceholder: Optional Imgur client ID for cover uploads
